summary: Verified the reported '401 Invalid signature' dispatch bug is FIXED after the LEARNFORGE_WEBHOOK_SECRET rotation sync. Backend: 6/6 pytest cases pass against the live staging receiver (https://learnforge-staging.vercel.app/api/course-generation-jobs) for signal 06981200-86b3-412e-9fa6-1578665160f5 — fresh dispatch returns ok:true, deduplicated:false, status_code 202, job.status 'accepted', http_status 202, non-null remote_job_id (9cf89642-10cf-4e7b-865e-d568d4947121) and status_url; repeat dispatch returns ok:true, deduplicated:true with the SAME job_id/remote_job_id; GET /api/signals/{id}/job-status returns 'accepted'; POST /api/course-jobs/{job_id}/refresh returns ok:true, status_code 200, status 'accepted' (live staging GET). No 401 / 'Invalid signature' / 'Signature rejected' anywhere in the job record, responses, or backend logs. Frontend: convert flow opened, dispatch-brief-btn clicked, job-status-chip renders 'accepted' with the ACCEPTED badge on section 05, no console/page errors, no crash; green dispatch-result-panel correctly hidden on the deduplicated path.
critical_code_review_comments: dispatcher.dispatch_brief correctly keeps HMAC signing over the compact sorted body and no legacy fallback; secret is read per-call from env so restarts pick up rotations — consider adding a startup log of secret length (never the value) to catch future rotation drift early.
seed_data_creation: None. Only writes were to the target signal: deleted its course_jobs row once to force a genuinely fresh (non-deduplicated) signed dispatch, which then re-created an accepted job. backend/.env untouched.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run `pytest tests/test_iter17_secret_rotation_401_fix.py -p no:randomly -o addopts=''` from /app/backend for the live-staging dispatch regression. Test 06 deletes course_jobs rows for the target signal to bypass Radar idempotency; the staging receiver itself is idempotent (returns the same remote_job_id for the same idempotency key). Staging cold start was not an issue (all calls <2s).
rca_of_the_issue: Original 401 was HMAC secret drift: staging rotated to a 64-char secret while Radar held the old 45-char value, so X-Radar-Signature failed verification. Confirmed backend/.env now holds a 64-char secret and the live receiver accepts the signature with HTTP 202. Bug resolved.
